name: Poljarnaja Zvezda
source:
A short and sweet visual novel about a girl who decides to enroll in an all-male military school. The game draws inspiration from the Russian literature curriculum and 19th-century history. It contains no political subtext, honestly.

[Translated from [url=https://nathanzutt.itch.io/nuance]Itch.io[/url]]

Originally made for Siberian Game Jam - November 2022.
